choices.content: Have respondents complete the questionnaire anonymously
Distribute the questionnaire randomly to students in different grades
Use clearly defined, non-overlapping intervals for the questionnaire's response options
Include the question “Don't you think playing games is a waste of time?”

question.prompt: A questionnaire survey is used to find out how much time students spend playing games each day. Which of the following practices is most likely to bias the results?

solutions.explanation: A leading question can influence respondents' answers and bias the results. The other practices all help obtain truthful data.
solutions.title: Identify leading wording
